organizing_function: Select and authorize eligible nationally designed measures
component_elements_and_attributes: Member State Plan preparation and consultation; Commission review and implementing decision; Commission authority with bounded evaluative discretion; information and resubmission accountability
architectural_significance_basis: Plan submission is a required gateway to allocation and Commission decision determines terms and eligibility
scope_limit: Does not establish quality/effect of participation or Commission practice

organizing_function: Allocate and disburse support against approved performance
component_elements_and_attributes: Direct Commission management; agreement; payment request; milestone/target assessment; suspension reduction termination; Member State comment opportunity
architectural_significance_basis: Payment authorization and specified consequences are consequential sequential stages; Commission role is difficult to substitute within this Fund
scope_limit: Does not infer payments actually made or outcome attainment

organizing_function: Implement supported measures and protect/trace Union funds
component_elements_and_attributes: Member State implementation and internal controls; biennial reporting; audit/data access; public transparency; Commission monitoring/evaluation and remedial links
architectural_significance_basis: Several complementary information and control paths connect national implementation to Commission and EU oversight; legal duties and consequences support structural importance
scope_limit: Not all oversight forums have identical powers; no implementation-effectiveness claim
